versions.name: Lost Lake Scout Camp

features.note: Home to the Northern Lights High Adventure Base, a nationally accredited high-adventure base.
Frontage on the 90-acre Lost Lake, between the Tanana River and Birch Lake.

versions.summary: Scouts BSA resident camp and Northern Lights High Adventure Base spanning more than 600 acres south of Fairbanks, Alaska.

provenance.notes: Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types. Website canonicalised 2026-07-25: https://www.midnightsunbsa.org/lost-lake-scout-camp/lost-lake-scout-camp.html now redirects to https://midnightsunbsa.org/lost-lake-scout-camp/ (link audit, tools/check_urls.py). Features surveyed 2026-07-25 against the council's own camp page (that page is explicitly not an exhaustive activity list, so absence of a code is not evidence of absence).
